newsitem.title: USA: Versa Lovdahl sale to reduce EPS slightly.
newsitem.headline: Versa Lovdahl sale to reduce EPS slightly.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc said Monday it completed the sale of Lovdahl Manufacturing to Kurz-Kasch Inc of Dayton, Ohio in a transaction that will reduce Versa's per-share earnings for the fiscal year ending March 31, 1997 by about $0.03 per share.
Under terms of the sale, Kurz-Kasch acquired substantially all of the assets of Lovdahl Manufacturing from Moxness Products Inc, a Versa subsidiary, for $1.5 million.
Lovdahl manufactures components from phenolic and thermoset plastics. Its fiscal 1997 sales are estimated at $2.6 million, with a nominal operating loss.

"The sale of Lovdahl is in keeping with our overall business strategy of moving away from commodity products and concentrating our efforts on our core businesses," said chairman James Mohrhauser in a statement.
Versa Technologies is comprised of three business segments -- electronics, engineered materials and fluid power.
